description: Each key of the vendored Autark grammar schema (utk_curio/backend/app/agents/schemas/autk-grammar.v1.json), by its path (utk_curio/backend/tests/_support/autk_key_paths.py), with the tests that run it on a path Curio runs a document on: a node's run, a run on the server, a compute step, the agents' document check. renamedKeys holds the keys autk-grammar 5 renamed, by their old names, with the tests that refuse them. An entry's test is a file of the repository and the test in it, :: between them; its document, the file the test reads its documents from; refused, a test that shows the key refused. utk_curio/backend/tests/test_agents/test_autk_every_key_tested.py checks it.
